items.source: Defaults to true, leading to an exception being thrown if the path variable is missing in the incoming request. Switch this to false if you prefer a null or Java 8 java.util.Optional in this case. for example, on a ModelAttribute method which serves for different requests.
items.translation: 默认为 `true`，如果传入请求中缺少路径变量，将抛出异常。如果您更倾向于在这种情况下返回 `null` 或 Java 8 `java.util.Optional`，请将其切换为 `false`。例如，在服务于不同请求的 `ModelAttribute` 方法上。

items.source: If the method parameter is Map<String, String> then the map is populated with all path variable names and values.
items.translation: 如果方法参数是 Map<String, String>，则映射表将填充所有路径变量名称和值。

items.source: The name of the path variable to bind to.
items.translation: 要绑定的路径变量名称。

items.source: Whether the path variable is required.
